fragment: When the connection pool is full, support for connection waiting
statement: All connections of the pool are in use (the pool is full); then a caller requests a connection; that caller waits instead of failing.

fragment: Release all connections in the connection pool
statement: A caller puts a connection back into the pool; afterwards Release is called; Release closes that returned connection.

fragment: the timeout connection will be closed and discarded
statement: An idle connection stays in the pool longer than the maximum idle time; afterwards a caller requests a connection; the pool closes and discards that expired connection instead of handing it out.
